[nation]United Hydronia[/nation]

This is an official statement by the President of Blarfghanistan broadcasted on national Television. 

My dear citizens and brothers and sisters all over this continent. Today is a day for celebration! Our MFA has just applied to be reinstated as a nation on the Maps of Cordone. After years of an unjust government and after many more years of war and bloodshed we shall stand once again, stand on our own, stand alongside this wonderful family of Cordone but stand we shall. 

What is a day for celebration is also a call for responsibility. A call to the past and a call to justice. A key player in the internment and prosecution of political dissidents under the unjust and bloodthirsty Schuhmann regime, Welphred Jost, has been tracked down after fleeing the country in 2021. This man who has brought pain and agony to so many of our brothers and sisters is hiding amidst the good and honorable people of Hydronia. 

Which is why I, my attorney general, my administration, my people and Justice itself call for the administration of Hydronia to extradite and or allow Blarfghanistans special forces to seize this stain on humanity. So that he can be brought to justice. 

And to Jost. I know you are listening, i know your men have already alerted you. But don't think that you can run forever. Dont think you will ever escape the righteous fury of my people dont think that the honorable people of Hydronia will tolerate you much more. Your days are numbered. May god have mercy on whatever is left of your wretched soul once we get you. 

Glory to Blarfghanistan and Glory to Hydronia [/quote]
